capabilities: define custom checkbox statuses with a bracket character and label
cycle checkboxes to the next or previous status by left-clicking
pick a specific status from a right-click context menu
jump directly to a status with per-status editor commands
bind cycling and status commands to keyboard shortcuts
extras: Without a supporting theme (e.g. Minimal, Things, AnuPpuccin, Cupertino) the status character still cycles in the source but checkboxes do not get a distinct visual rendering.
intentEvidence: Switch Obsidian checkboxes between customizable statuses via click, keyboard shortcut, or context menu.
problem: Obsidian checkboxes only toggle between checked and unchecked, so multi-step task states have no built-in support.
